anomalies.observed: PCA9685PW address pin A0 (pin 1) is tied to +3.3V while A1 to A5 go to GND. The schematic note on the same sheet reads "I2C address: 0x41".
anomalies.expected: The specification lists the PCA9685PW I2C address as 0x40, which requires A0 to be tied to GND like the other address pins.
